assets.name: warm-taupe
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: floor color architectural design study A for the Korean first-person writing cafe "쓰는 인간", NOT an implemented app screenshot.
Edit target: the supplied approved cafe interior. Preserve the EXACT camera, layout, central six-seat oak table, window writing desks, rainy garden windows, walnut shelves and counter, olive linen bench, books, notebooks and pens, pale plaster walls and ceiling, brass pendants, daylight, exposure and readable warm local lighting.
Change ONLY the FLOOR to a notably darker low-to-mid lightness WARM TAUPE honed stone: a restrained mushroom/earthy gray-brown with warm undertones, base material color approximately #8D7B68. Clearly darker than the current ivory floor but still soft, welcoming and warm. Use large 600x900mm matte limestone slabs, quiet fine pores, subtle soft per-slab differences, very thin warm matching grout slightly darker than the stone, absolutely no gloss or bold veining. Broad soft window reflections and contact shadows reveal the texture while the floor remains matte. Keep the oak tabletop and cream paper clearly brighter than the floor. The floor should ground the room and feel like a comforting literary refuge.
Do NOT darken the entire photograph, change the time of day, dim the lamps, add a vignette or make the walls muddy/orange. The user is choosing a darker floor material, not an underexposed room. Preserve the original bright readable ambient light and subtle warmth. No furniture changes, additional props, people, avatar, third-person camera, UI, labels, captions, color swatches, comparison panels, borders or watermark. Retain the existing Korean signage only. One full-frame landscape 16:10 photoreal concept from the same FIRST-PERSON standing view.

assets.name: warm-mocha
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: floor material design study B for the Korean first-person writing cafe "쓰는 인간"; proposal image, NOT an app screenshot.
Edit target: the supplied original ivory-floor cafe. Preserve precisely the SAME first-person standing camera, composition, all furniture and books, rainy window garden, oak communal table, walnut cabinets, olive bench, pale plaster ceiling and walls, brass lights, soft window fill and warm readable exposure.
Change ONLY the FLOOR to a low-lightness WARM MOCHA BROWN matte stone: muted cocoa/umber-brown with a little gray to keep it quiet, approximately #725E4D as the base material, visibly deeper and more enveloping than warm taupe. Large 600x900mm honed stone slabs, subtle natural fine pores and tiny tonal differences, thin matching dark warm grout. Soft local light catches the floor near writing desks and chair legs. Keep it clearly brown and cozy, not black, charcoal, blue-gray, orange terracotta or wooden planks. The oak top and cream cotton paper must feel luminous above this grounded darker floor.
Keep original wall/ceiling brightness, daylight and lamp intensity. Do not apply an all-over dark filter, vignette, orange color cast, night mood or underexposure. Preserve readable shelf contents, true timber grain and soft contact shadows. No other material changes, new props, room enlargement, people, avatar, third-person camera, UI, labels, captions, comparison panels, swatches, border or watermark. Existing signage only. One full-frame landscape 16:10 photoreal architectural concept, exactly the same room and camera as the source.

direction: 바닥 재질의 명도를 낮추되 조도·벽·천장·종이의 밝기는 유지한다.
recommendation: B는 더 짙고 포근한 모카, A는 더 부드러운 웜 토프. 바닥 선택 전에는 앱의 기존 석재를 유지한다.
implementation_boundary: 선택된 B안의 모카 바닥을 적용하고 벽·조명·가구의 세부를 구현한다. A안은 비교 이력이다.

role_review.designer: 같은 공간과 조도에서 바닥만 어둡게 비교한다. 화면 전체를 어둡게 만들지 않는다.
role_review.planner: 사용자가 3인칭을 철회했으므로 기존 1인칭 공간과 걷기에 집중한다.
role_review.marketer: 생성 시안과 실제 앱 적용을 구분한다.
role_review.developer: 아바타/3인칭 구현을 제거하되 경로·가감속·키보드·입력/저장 검증을 유지한다.
